extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: The most extensive and diverse open-source Multimodal INTerleaved dataset to date, comprising one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images, sourced from HTML, PDFs, and ArXiv papers.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.publisher: University of Washington, Salesforce Research, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, University of Califomia Berkeley
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MINT-1T curates a large-scale open-source dataset that taps into more diverse sources of interleaved documents such as PDFs and ArXiv papers. This involves sourcing multimodal documents, filtering low-quality documents, deduplicating data, and removing not safe for work and undesirable content.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Document analysis, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: None. Documents with missing or non-retrievable image links were removed.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CommonCrawl WARC files, CommonCrawl WAT files, ArXiv papers
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: January 2024 to June 2024 (collection process); Web data from 2013 to 2024 (content timeframe)
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Email addresses were replaced with templates such as 'email@example.com' and IP addresses were replaced with randomly generated non-functional IPs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering low-quality documents, deduplicating data, removing NSFW content. Specific steps: eliminate non-English documents, remove documents with excessive duplicate n-grams or low quality per MassiveText rules, remove images smaller than 150 pixels or larger than 20,000 pixels, remove images with aspect ratio >2 (HTML) or >3 (PDF), NSFW image detection, PII anonymization, paragraph and document text deduplication (Bloom Filter), removing common boilerplate text, and image deduplication (SHA256 hashes).
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: NSFW image detector, Fasttext language identification model
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Authors will actively respond to issues and maintain the dataset. Updates will be communicated through the README in the Huggingface interface. Older versions can be found using the Git history. Contributions accepted via Pull Requests.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Email addresses and IP addresses were anonymized. However, it is possible to find images of individuals and text about specific individuals, as well as sensitive data (race, ethnic origins, etc.) if present on the public web.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: An important consideration is avoiding exposing harmful content from the web. Future work should explore more ways to improve the safety of multimodal internet data. Inappropriate use cases include training models to ingest/generate PII or military applications.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Text quality classifier models were avoided as they favor text from certain demographics. OBELICS is concentrated in Humanities and Social Sciences; MINT-1T's HTML subset is not strongly biased towards any specific domain, while the PDF subset has a higher proportion of Science and Technology documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: PDF parsing issues include inability to detect images and incorrect reading order extraction. The dataset is not self-contained and relies on external image URLs which may suffer from link rot. It may contain confidential or offensive content despite filtering efforts.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Pre-training large multimodal models, generating interleaved images and text sequences, building multimodal document retrieval systems.
